placards.curatorialNote: Rendered in ink, vibrant color, and gold leaf on paper, this screen study features rhythmic clusters of irises. Vertical stalks and curved leaves establish a crisp visual cadence across warm metallic planes. Anchoring our botanical theme, the composition organizes living floral structures into balanced decorative forms that energize the open viewing space.

Executed in oil on canvas using meticulous dots of paint, this landscape balances upright human silhouettes with spreading park trees. Seurat organizes sunlight and shadow through a calculated geometric grid. Highlighting both architectural discipline and botanical surroundings, the structured composition frames modern city life within a carefully planned natural public park.

Produced as a polychrome woodblock print on paper, this work frames distant Mount Fuji beneath a towering, claw-like wave. Strong diagonal lines and layered blue tones anchor the low wooden boats. Connecting to our architectural theme, the curling water forms a vaulted, sheltering curve that frames the permanent geometry of the horizon.
